page.overview:
Who is C Tier Fighters?

The C Tier Fighters are a group of characters that debuted in Street Fighter: Duel. They are the easiest characters that can be recruited in the game with the cost of having reduced or otherwise absent features of SSS Tier and S Tier characters. As such, they are mostly presented as fighters, thugs, soldiers, and doctors, usually with tragic pasts or ambitious goals, that lead the majority of them to be aligned with Shadaloo, S.I.N., or the Mad Gear Gang.

Akaebo (赤前坊) is Japanese member of Mad Gear who specializes in throwing molotov cocktails and explosive gas cans. Growing up in poverty, Akaebo's mother struggled to find work and feed their family. He was encouraged by his mother to study and school to ensure a better life for himself.

Baldwin (鲍德温) is an English mechanical engineer, researcher, and soldier working for S.I.N. He built his own massive mech suit equipped with a minigun and flame thrower. Inside the mech suit, he is the largest playable character in Street Fighter: Duel. Dr. Baldwin believed in the ability of machines to advance mankind, if they're perfectly designed. So unwavering is this belief that he immediately balked at the thought that his research could also harm humanity.

Bethany (贝瑟妮) is an unconventional medic and scientist who uses multicolored chemicals to heal her allies or attack her enemies. The daughter of a wealthy Englishman, she was provided pharmaceutical company after her college graduation to further he research into new prototype drugs.
